fact: The IMPULSE study (Nov 2022-Jul 2024) found DHIS2 in use as the routine health information system in central and subnational data offices in Ethiopia.

A cross-sectional survey of 220 staff in public health facilities in Harari Regional State and Dire Dawa City Administration (June-July 2020) found DHIS2 in use there, with about 45% of staff using its data.

DHIS2 and the Ministry of Health say the DHIS2-based national HMIS reached all 30,000+ public health facilities by 2024, after full national implementation began in 2017, and held over 1 billion records by 2025.
